recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the CDS work group wants explicit Library-specific operational semantics beyond the current general Using Expressions guidance and Library.subject metadata.
issue_request: FHIR-39528 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 clarification asking that knowledge artifacts with a subject/subjectType element evaluate expressions in the subject context, documented in Using Expressions and in the Measure, PlanDefinition, ActivityDefinition, and Library overview discussions.
initial_application: HL7/fhir#3411 merged commit 67989bee777b5e31b8065968748cc29aa4f5fb34, which added the general Using Expressions subject-context paragraph and resource-local ActivityDefinition and PlanDefinition notes. No prior AutoFHIR reconcile commit for FHIR-39528 was present on the combined branch.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes Library, Measure, ActivityDefinition, and PlanDefinition, and source/hierarchy.xml includes the Clinical Reasoning Using Expressions page. Measure guidance already states that subject determines the criteria-expression perspective, and later FHIR-51574 refined Measure-specific root/group subject behavior. Library has subject metadata but no core Library operation-specific evaluation page, so the general Using Expressions topic is the appropriate non-redundant location for the Library-facing rule.
reconciliation: No source changes were made. The active general topic plus ActivityDefinition, PlanDefinition, and Measure guidance already convey the approved rule; a new Library-only restatement would be redundant and could imply operation semantics not otherwise defined for Library in core.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied Measure-specific issue deprecated root Measure.subject and clarified that missing group.subject means unfiltered CQL context; used as context, not decided here.
